# Bina Labs

> Bina Labs is a consultancy of engineers, researchers, and strategists that builds AI systems which earn their seat at the production table. Tel Aviv, Berlin, remote-first.

We work with companies who need real AI in production - not slideware. Median ship time is 11 days. 84% of clients return for a second engagement. We engage four ways: AI strategy intensives, embedded engineering squads, lectures and workshops, and applied research.

The principal is Michael Fleicher - engineer, data scientist, founder, two-time CTO with backgrounds across MedTech, Insurance, Entertainment, and Semi-conductors. Building agentic systems and automations since 2017.

Operating principles: deadlines are holy; AI assistants are tools, not authors; honest deprecation (we tell clients when a project should die and refund the rest); built to leave (every embedded engagement comes with a written hand-off plan from day one).

## Selected case studies

- [Match Cuts](https://bina-labs.com/#case-study/match-cuts): VLM-based auto-edited highlight reels from full football matches (90 min match condensed to 3 min per player)
- [Auto-QTO](https://bina-labs.com/#case-study/auto-qto): Hybrid VLM extracting bills of materials from dense construction drawings (92% symbol recall)
- [Lloyd Score](https://bina-labs.com/#case-study/lloyd-score): Spatial AI quantifying near-miss risk for marine insurers (AIS-grade ghost-fleet simulations)
- [Caseworker](https://bina-labs.com/#case-study/caseworker): Embedded customer-experience copilot with smart sub-tree LLM, handwriting OCR, full CRM integration (-47% handle time)
- [Field Atlas](https://bina-labs.com/#work): Single source of truth for distributed field operations
- [Telemetra](https://bina-labs.com/#work): Natural-language flight analysis
- [AskTable](https://bina-labs.com/#work): Self-healing SQL agent
- [Reachpoint](https://bina-labs.com/#work): Real-time hand range-of-motion tracking

## Services

- [AI Strategy](https://bina-labs.com/#services): 4-week intensives. Where to bet, where to wait, what to ignore. Roadmap, evals, org-design
- [AI / Software Engineering](https://bina-labs.com/#services): Embedded squads that ship product and the AI plumbing underneath - full-stack, RAG, agents, on-prem
- [Lectures & Workshops](https://bina-labs.com/#services): Tailored sessions for R&D teams and executives. What is real, what is one paper away, what is marketing
- [Research](https://bina-labs.com/#services): Applied research with frontier teams. Sometimes a paper. Occasionally a product
